items.t: Said she is most proud to be "a small-town kid from the mountains of Eastern Kentucky."
items.q: While it may be notable that I will be the first woman to serve as chief justice in Kentucky, I am most proud to be a small-town kid from the mountains of Eastern Kentucky who has had a lot of support and encouragement along the way.” Chief Justice-elect Lambert was elected as a justice of the Supreme Court in November 2018 from the 3rd Supreme Court District, which is made up of 25 counties.

record.t: Began serving as chief justice in January 2025 after her colleagues elected her to a four-year term; the first woman to hold the post in Kentucky.
record.q: Chief Justice Lambert began serving as chief justice in January 2025 after being elected to the post for a four-year term by her colleagues.

record.t: Was appointed chair of the newly created Kentucky Judicial Mental Health Commission in 2022.
record.q: Minton appointed Chief Justice Lambert as Chair of the newly created Kentucky Judicial Mental Health Commission​ in 2022.

record.t: Was formally sworn in as a justice of the Supreme Court of Kentucky at a state Capitol ceremony after being elected in November to serve the 3rd Supreme Court District (2019).
record.q: Justice Debra Hembree Lambert was formally sworn in as a justice of the Supreme Court of Kentucky at a ceremony Monday at the state Capitol in Frankfort.

record.office: Circuit Judge, Family Court, 28th Judicial Circuit
record.t: Served as Circuit Judge, Family Court division, for the 28th Judicial Circuit (Lincoln, Pulaski and Rockcastle counties).
record.q: Prior to taking the appellate bench, Chief Justice Lambert was a Circuit Judge/ Family Court Division for the 28th Judicial Circuit, composed of Lincoln, Pulaski and Rockcastle counties.

record.t: Practiced law in Mount Vernon as an assistant commonwealth's attorney and city attorney.
record.q: Chief Justice Lambert practiced law in Mount Vernon, Ky, serving as an Assistant Commonwealth's Attorney and City Attorney for the city of Mount Vernon.
